core_claim.P: A user has a pending redeem request while the vault is being set inactive and unregistered by the Owner.
core_claim.I: The vault must not be unregistered/removed while any pending redeem request exists (pendingRedeemCheck / activeRedeemRequestersCount must reflect pending redeems).
core_claim.V: activeRedeemRequestersCount can be made 0 despite a pending redeem request, so the vault can be unregistered and removed while a redeem is still pending.

distinct_impacts.description: The user's shares are stuck in the removed vault with no asset to redeem them against.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the shares sent by user are stuck because of it

distinct_impacts.description: Because the vault is inactive and removed, no one else can deposit to the vault, leaving the shares with no asset to redeem against.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: since vault is inactive and removed now no one else can deposit to vault, the shares will be stuck with no asset to redeem it with in removed vault

distinct_impacts.description: A pending redeem request can be ignored by the Owner when setting the vault inactive and unregistering it.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: a pending redeem request can be ignored by the Owner when setting vault inactive and unregistering the vault

distinct_impacts.description: Missing pendingRedeemCheck and an execution flow allow activeRedeemRequestersCount to become 0 despite a pending redeem request.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: missing pendingRedeemCheck and a flow of execution where, the `activeRedeemRequestersCount` can be made 0 despite a pending redeem request

distinct_impacts.description: Claiming the original fulfilled redeem removes the controller from activeRedeemRequesters even though another pending redeem request is active.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: controller is removed from `activeRedeemRequesters` despite there being another pending redeem request being active currently
